title: StartLocationDef
description:
A start location definition from JSON type `"start_location"`.

Defines where a character can start the game (e.g. "shelter", "evac_center", "lab").

exclude.description: List of starting locations that are excluded.

flags.description: List of specific OMT IDs where this start can occur.

shelter.description: Whether this start location contains a shelter.

terrain.description: Target terrain for the start location (can be string, array, or object).

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
